e.summary_en: This is an Indian postal life insurance premium calculator whose own description expands the acronym incorrectly, describing itself in writing as an application for calculating product liability insurance premiums while its feature list covers endowment assurance, whole life assurance, convertible whole life, and anticipated endowment and points to the national postal insurer. **Measured this round**: created and pushed on the tenth of September about three minutes apart, a repository of ten kilobytes in a cross-platform mobile framework, no stars, no licence file, and a description of about six kilobytes over two hundred four lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of filling thin lines of business, and it lands on life insurance, the thinnest category, and on the Indian market.** **Four things are worth reading: the acronym is expanded wrongly, which is a common error in real reference material, since the description says product liability while the features list four life products under the postal insurer, so this entry records the mismatch and treats the real domain as postal life insurance; the rate formula is published in writing, with a base rate of three point five plus the age multiplied by a small coefficient per thousand of sum assured, and the annual premium derived from it, so a small tool that documents its formula can be recomputed; payment modes and their rebates are tabulated, running from monthly with no rebate to yearly with the largest; and the bonus estimate is given as a fixed amount per thousand of sum assured per year accumulated over a twenty-year term, which means it produces an educational maturity illustration rather than an actuarial price.** **The application was neither compiled nor run this round.**
e.body:
**PLI & RPLI Premium Calculator**（`arnavicompany/PLI-RPLI-CALCULATOR`）**是一个**印度**邮政寿险**的**保费**计算器****——**⭐ 而**其**自述逐字为**「**A comprehensive Flutter application for calculating Product Liability Insurance (PLI) and Recall Product Liability Insurance (RPLI) premiums with real-time estimations.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**补**覆盖薄的**业务线**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-12 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① ⚠️ 缩写**被**解释**错**，**而**这**正好**是**资料**里**最**常见的**一类**错误****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 自述**逐字**说**它**算**「**Product Liability Insurance (PLI)**」**与**「**Recall Product Liability Insurance (RPLI)**」**，**而**其**功能**清单**逐字**列**四种**产品**：**Endowment Assurance (Santosh)**（**逐字**：**traditional endowment plan with guaranteed maturity benefits）**、**Whole Life Assurance (Suraksha)**、**Convertible Whole Life (Suvidha)** 与 **Anticipated Endowment (Sumangal)**，**并**逐字**说明**「**various PLI and RPLI policies offered by India Post Insurance**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**判定**：**⭐ 即 **PLI／**RPLI** 实**为 **Postal Life Insurance／**Rural Postal Life Insurance**（**印度**邮政**寿险**与**农村**邮政**寿险）**——**⭐ 而**「**一个有**似是而非**全称的**缩写**」**是**最**容易**被**照抄**的**错误**：**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**看到**缩写**时**，**用**它**的**功能**清单**去**反**验**全称**（**⭐ 本条**的**功能**全是**寿险**产品**、**且**指向**邮政**机构**，**故**全称**必**不是**产品**责任**险）**。

**⭐⭐ ② 费率**公式**逐字**公开**，**而**这**让**小**工具**也**可**被**复算****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**给出**（**逐字**：**Base Rate = 3.5 + (Age × 0.08) per ₹1000 sum assured** 与 **Annual Premium = (Sum Assured / 1000) × Base Rate × 12**）**，**并**逐字**说明**年龄**范围**（**逐字**：**Age-based calculation - Premiums adjusted based on proposer age (19-55 years)**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一点**值得**表扬**：**⭐ 即**一个 **10 KB** 的**工具**，**若**把**公式**写**在**文档**里**，**读**的人**就**能**不**运行**它**也**知道**它**怎么**算**——**⭐ 反之**，**一个**几十 **MB** 的**系统**若**不**写**公式**，**读**的人**反而**只能**猜**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 缴费**方式**与**折让**逐字**成表****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**给出**四档**（**逐字**：**Monthly **1/12** 与 **0%**；**Quarterly **0.25** 与 **0.5%**；**Half-Yearly **0.5** 与 **1%**；**Yearly **1.0** 与 **2%**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 即**「**年缴**折让**最高**」**是**多数**寿险**产品的**通行**做法**，**而**它**在**这里**被**表**格化**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**比较**缴费**方式**时**，**要**同时**看**乘数**与**折让**，**而**不**只**看**折让**百分比**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 红利**与**到期**价值**是**教育性**估算**，**而**不**是**精算**定价****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**给出**（**逐字**：**Estimated Bonus = (Sum Assured / 1000) × ₹52 per year**、**Total Bonus (20-year term) = Estimated Bonus × 20**、**Maturity Value = Sum Assured + Total Bonus**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**把**红利**写成**一个**固定**年**额**，**是**一种**示意**式**算法**（**真**实**分红**取决**于**资产**份额**与**红利**分配**机制）**——**⭐ 故**它**适合**教学**与**快速**估算**，**不**适合**作为**销售**口径**引用**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程**形态**与**限制****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库 **10 KB**、**主语言 **Dart**（**Flutter**）**、**星标 **0**、**⚠️ 无许可证****；**⭐ README 逐字**含**安装**、**生产**构建**、**应用**结构**与**计算**逻辑**四节**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**仓库**体量**小**（**10 KB**）**，**故**其**价值**在于**公式**与**界面**的**说明**，**而**不**在**工程**规模**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[detlifeinsurance]] 覆盖**确定性**寿险**计算**、**[[tvm-python]] 覆盖**货币**时间**价值**计算**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**一国**邮政**寿险**产品**为**对象**的**移动端**保费**计算器**＋**公式**公开**」这一**形态**，**并**顺带**记录了**一处**缩写**误读**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **用**功能**清单**反**验**缩写**全称**；**② **把**公式**写**进**文档**；**③ **缴费**方式**同时**看**乘数**与**折让**；**④ **分红**示意**算法**不**当**销售**口径**；**⑤ **小**仓库**的**价值**可以**在于**说明**，**而**不**在于**规模**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有编译、**没有运行**该 **Flutter** 应用**（**未**安装 **Flutter SDK**、**未**构建 **APK**）**，**故**不主张**其**计算**结果**与**界面**行为**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **Dart** 源码**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**费率**公式**与**任一**邮政**寿险**产品的**官方**费率**是否**一致**（**⭐ 本词条**只**记录**其**自述**公式**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**印度**邮政**或**任何**机构**的**关系**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说**产品**是**该**机构**提供**的**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **本词条**对**缩写**的判断**是**基于**其**功能**清单**与**机构**指向**的**推断**，**并**已**在**正文**中**标明**为**推断**。**⑥ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-12 所见**；**⚠️ 该工具**是**教育性**计算器**，**不**是**官方**费率**来源**，**也**不**是**投保建议**。

**PLI & RPLI Premium Calculator**（`arnavicompany/PLI-RPLI-CALCULATOR`）**是一個**印度**郵政壽險**的**保費**計算器****——**⭐ 而**其**自述逐字為**「**A comprehensive Flutter application for calculating Product Liability Insurance (PLI) and Recall Product Liability Insurance (RPLI) premiums with real-time estimations.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**補覆蓋薄的業務線**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-12 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① ⚠️ 縮寫被解釋錯****——**自述逐字說算**Product Liability Insurance (PLI)** 與 **Recall Product Liability Insurance (RPLI)**，**而功能清單逐字列四種產品**：Endowment Assurance (Santosh)（**逐字**traditional endowment plan with guaranteed maturity benefits**）、**Whole Life Assurance (Suraksha)**、**Convertible Whole Life (Suvidha)** 與 **Anticipated Endowment (Sumangal)**，**並逐字說明**various PLI and RPLI policies offered by India Post Insurance**；**⭐ 即 PLI／RPLI 實為 Postal Life Insurance／Rural Postal Life Insurance**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**看到縮寫時**，**用它的功能清單反驗全稱**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 繳費方式與折讓成表****——**Monthly 0%**、**Quarterly 0.5%**、**Half-Yearly 1%**、**Yearly 2%**；**⭐ 即**比較時要同時看乘數與折讓**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 紅利與到期價值是教育性估算****——**Estimated Bonus = (Sum Assured / 1000) × ₹52 per year**、**Total Bonus (20-year term)**、**Maturity Value = Sum Assured + Total Bonus**；**⭐ 即**分紅示意算法**不當銷售口徑**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形態與限制****——**10 KB**、**Dart（**Flutter）**、**星標 0**、**⚠️ 無許可證**；**⭐ 即**小倉庫的價值在於說明而非規模**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[detlifeinsurance]]、[[tvm-python]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以一國郵政壽險產品為對象的移動端保費計算器＋**公式公開**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **用功能清單反驗縮寫**；**② **公式寫進文檔**；**③ **繳費同時看乘數與折讓**；**④ **分紅示意不當銷售口徑**；**⑤ **小倉庫價值可在於說明**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有編譯、**沒有運行**該 Flutter 應用**，**不主張**其計算結果與介面行為**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 Dart 源碼**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其費率公式與任一產品的官方費率是否一致**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其與印度郵政或任何機構的關係**。**⑤ ⚠️ **本詞條**對縮寫的判斷**是**基於功能清單與機構指向的**推斷**，**已**在正文標明**。**⑥ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-12 所見**；**⚠️ 該工具是教育性計算器**，**不是**官方費率來源**，**也**不是**投保建議**。
e.body_en:
This is an Indian postal life insurance premium calculator whose own description expands the acronym incorrectly. **This entry belongs to the round theme of filling thin lines of business.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-12 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the acronym is expanded wrongly, which is a common error in reference material.** The description says it calculates product liability insurance and recall product liability insurance premiums, while the feature list names endowment assurance with guaranteed maturity benefits, whole life assurance, convertible whole life, and anticipated endowment, and states that these are policies offered by the national postal insurer. **That combination identifies the real domain as postal life insurance and rural postal life insurance rather than product liability cover, and the lesson is that an acronym with a plausible-looking expansion is the easiest thing to copy, so the feature list should be used to test the expansion, since life products pointing at a postal institution cannot be liability cover.**

**Second, the rate formula is published in writing, which lets even a small tool be recomputed.** The description gives a base rate of three point five plus the age multiplied by a small coefficient per thousand of sum assured, and derives the annual premium from it, with a stated age range from nineteen to fifty-five. **A ten-kilobyte tool that documents its formula lets a reader know how it computes without running it, whereas a large system that documents nothing leaves the reader guessing.**

**Third, payment modes and their rebates are tabulated.** Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and yearly options carry progressive rebates running from none to the largest. **The yearly option carrying the largest rebate is common practice in life products, and comparing payment modes means reading both the multiplier and the rebate rather than the rebate percentage alone.**

**Fourth, the bonus and maturity figure are an educational illustration rather than an actuarial price.** The description derives an estimated bonus as a fixed amount per thousand of sum assured per year, accumulates it over a twenty-year term, and adds it to the sum assured. **Writing the bonus as a flat annual amount is a schematic computation, since real participating business depends on asset shares and the bonus distribution mechanism, so the result suits teaching and quick estimation rather than sales language.**

**Fifth, the engineering form and its limits.** The repository is ten kilobytes, written in a cross-platform mobile framework, with no stars and no licence file, and the description carries installation, production build, application structure, and calculation logic sections. **The small size means its value lies in the formula and the interface explanation rather than in engineering scale.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover deterministic life calculations and time-value-of-money computation, **while this entry supplies the form of a mobile premium calculator for one country postal life products with a published formula, and records a mis-expanded acronym along the way. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: test an acronym expansion against the feature list; publish the formula; read both multiplier and rebate when comparing payment modes; never use a schematic bonus as sales language; and remember that a small repository may be valuable for its explanation rather than its scale.**
